big_case.notes: Pro se emergency stay application in a single-property Connecticut foreclosure, resting on fact-bound ADA Title II / due-process accommodation claims in an unfinished state case; denied by the Circuit Justice alone in two days with no response, referral, amicus or writing. Grave for the applicant, no reach beyond the parties.

No disposition of this application surfaced; forward default stands, with the caveat that the corpus rows returned are not visible to me.
